title: Reward tokens can be withdrawn without fee
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  InterPol takes a cut of the rewards accrued from staking of the tokens locked in the protocol when withdrawing the reward tokens. The rewards can be withdrawn with the `withdrawERC20` function, which also sends the fee to the protocol. However, users can use the `withdrawLPToken` function to bypass the fee. This happens due to the lines checking if the withdrawn token is a reward token being commented out, as seen in the snippet:  ```Solidity     function withdrawLPToken(address _LPToken, uint256 _amountOrId) external onlyU
